calculators.title: Mechanics of Materials
calculators.desc: Stress, strain, shear, torsion, Poisson's ratio, thermal stress and 30 materials.

calculators.title: Shear Stress Calculator
calculators.desc: Bolts and pins in single or double shear, punching, and twisted shafts.

calculators.title: Tensile Test Simulator
calculators.desc: Pull a bar until it breaks and watch the stress-strain curve, necking and toughness.

calculators.title: Young's Modulus Calculator
calculators.desc: Stress, strain and stretch of a bar from any four values, with a live picture.

calculators.title: Matrix Calculator
calculators.desc: Type or paste matrices into a grid: multiply, invert, determinants, eigenvalues and SVD with the working shown, plus softmax, a neural-network layer and attention.

calculators.title: Geometry & Angle Lab
calculators.desc: Drag triangles, lines and circles and watch the angles update.

calculators.title: Trigonometry Calculator
calculators.desc: Unit circle, triangle solver, graphs, tables and identities.

calculators.title: Volume, Area & Surface Area Calculator
calculators.desc: Volume, area and surface area of 27 shapes, with every formula.

calculators.title: Body Surface Area Calculator
calculators.desc: BSA by ten formulas for adults and children, plus clinical helpers.

calculators.title: One-Rep Max Calculator
calculators.desc: Estimate your 1RM from a set, with a rep chart, plate loader and strength level.

calculators.title: Pregnancy Calorie Calculator
calculators.desc: Extra calories by trimester or breastfeeding, and healthy weight gain by week.

calculators.title: Calories Burned Calculator
calculators.desc: Calories burned by 80+ activities for your weight, with a weekly plan.

tools.title: Letter and Digit Recognition
tools.desc: Train a small network to read digits and letters, draw a character and see what it thinks, test it on unseen fonts, and teach it your handwriting.

tools.title: Neural Network Playground
tools.desc: Train a real neural network in your browser: pick the data, layers and activation, and watch the decision boundary, the loss and every hidden neuron.

tools.title: Toy Language Model Simulator
tools.desc: See how a language model works in miniature: tokens, next-word probabilities, temperature, word vectors and attention.

tools.title: Font Preview and Finder
tools.desc: Type your text and see it in every font, with shadow, outline, gradient and glow. Download a transparent PNG, copy the CSS, or find a font from a picture.

tools.title: Video Compressor
tools.desc: Make MP4 and MOV videos smaller: aim for a file size like 25 MB, lower the resolution, save as MP4 or WebM. Fast, and nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Photo Editor
tools.desc: Free online editor with layers, selections, clone stamp, levels and curves. Add labels, arrows and callouts, combine images, keep transparency, open PSD. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Redshift & Blueshift Simulator
tools.desc: Why light changes colour: near and far from a heavy mass, moving sources, a spectrum shifter and the expanding universe, with real numbers.

tools.title: Compressor: Pictures, PDFs, Audio
tools.desc: Make JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF and audio files smaller with a before and after preview. Private: nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: MES Favourites
tools.desc: Build your own page of favourite mes.fm calculators and tools: search, drag into groups, and take it to any device with one link.

tools.title: PDF Tools: Merge, Split, Convert
tools.desc: Merge, split, rearrange, compress and convert PDFs and pictures. Private: nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: PDF Editor
tools.desc: Sign, fill in, annotate, highlight, redact and edit text in a PDF. Private: it never leaves your browser.

tools.title: Ground Rod & Earthing Simulator
tools.desc: Find a ground rod's resistance for your soil, see why a rod doesn't trip a breaker, model lightning step voltage and static discharge, and read the grounding rules for your region.
